decisions.rationale: Aniridia in the title names a single specific congenital eye disease that has its own definition, so it is a Specific Disease.

decisions.rationale: congenital malformation of the eye is a broad category that could describe a family of multiple specific eye malformations, not one defined disease, so it is a Disease Class.

decisions.rationale: iris hypoplasia is a phenotypic feature (a sign) described as characterising aniridia, not a disease name, so it is not annotated.
